recognize_zh: 多個紅血球邊緣有成簇、細小不規則的藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），同時可見大量標靶細胞、船形／鐮刀狀紅血球與偶見單一圓點的 Howell-Jolly 小體，符合鐮刀型貧血脾功能低下。
features: Multiple small, irregular basophilic granules clustered at the periphery of many red cells (Pappenheimer bodies)
Occasional single round dense inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body
Scattered crenated cells (echinocytes) and platelets in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many target cells and scattered elongated boat-shaped sickle forms. Numerous erythrocytes contain small clusters of irregular basophilic granules located near the cell membrane, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, and an occasional cell contains a single round Howell-Jolly body. A few crenated cells are present. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with functional hyposplenism; a Prussian blue stain would confirm the siderotic nature of the granules.

ddx.vs: Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, smooth-edged and larger, and do not stain with Prussian blue.
Stippling is evenly distributed throughout the red cell rather than clustered at one edge, and is iron negative.
Hb C disease shows target cells and intraerythrocytic rhomboid crystals but not sickle forms.
Superimposed platelets are larger, granular and often surrounded by a pale halo.
